cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a small shop — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — lying on her front; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — standing
